We will be supporting the following default Gutenberg blocks:

## Common
- [ ] Paragraph
- [ ] Heading
- [ ] List
- [ ] Image
- [ ] Quote
- [ ] File (TBD) (like Button but can only link to assets, not pages)
- [ ] Gallery
- [ ] Audio
- [ ] Cover

## Formatting
- [ ] Pullquote (removed since it uses the same styles as Quote)
- [ ] Table
- [ ] Code
- [ ] Preformatted
- [ ] Verse (same as Preformatted but typically doesn’t use a monospace font)
- [ ] Classic (old WYSIWYG editor) (no custom code required)
- [ ] Custom HTML (no custom code required)

## Layout Elements
- [ ] Button
- [ ] Columns
- [ ] Separator (horz rule)
- [ ] More (“read more” link cutoff) (no custom code required)
- [ ] Spacer (no code required)
- [ ] Media and Text
- [ ] Page break (ends page and inserts pagination to view remaining content)

## Embeds
Note: No custom code is required for any of these.

- [ ] YouTube
- [ ] Vimeo
- [ ] SoundCloud
- [ ] Twitter
- [ ] Facebook
- [ ] Instagram
- [ ] Spotify

See full list of embeds supported by WP
